semantic_contract.entry: frozen E1 next legal executable minute open
semantic_contract.target: frozen primary-layer U; first legal T+1-or-later execution
semantic_contract.time_stop: entry_cal_idx+40 completed-session close when legal, otherwise first later legal open; QD-010 known pre-effective risk exit may preempt
semantic_contract.h40_interpretation: newly frozen Development translation motivated by prior 20-40D incremental resolution; not an independently validated optimum
semantic_contract.h40_reproduction_anchor: all 538 prior anatomy events must exactly reproduce full_or_h40 validity and exit kind, and reproduce dividend-aware net return within 1e-12, before any portfolio outcome is accepted

lanes.L3_DUAL_FRESH: zone_age_sessions<=90 and cum_turnover_since_zone<=the same board-and-fold TRAIN-only cutoff

turnover_cutoff.population: otherwise-valid frozen E1 feature observations for the same board and TRAIN years, irrespective of portfolio execution or outcome

portfolio.new_position_target: min(5% current sleeve NAV, available cash)
portfolio.combined: fixed 50% independently replayed Main sleeve plus 50% independently replayed ChiNext sleeve; no capital transfer
portfolio.lane_selection: none; all four fixed lanes carried through every fold

metrics.signal_count: admitted valid signals before capacity and duplicate-position constraints
metrics.executed_trade_count: positions actually admitted into the K20 portfolio, whether or not H40 exit is observable before 2021-12-31
metrics.completed_trade_count: executed positions with a frozen target/time/action exit observed by period end; trade-return statistics use completed trades
metrics.cagr: chronological stitched NAV CAGR only; never mean trade return times frequency
metrics.concentration: compound daily NAV returns after removing the best one or five daily returns

verdict_implementation.material_trade_improvement: versus board-matched baseline, mean and median completed net trade return each improve by at least 25 bp
verdict_implementation.material_combined_portfolio_improvement: combined CAGR improves by at least 1.00 percentage point, total return improves, MaxDD is not worse by more than 2.00 points, and the lane beats baseline combined calendar return in at least three of five test years
verdict_implementation.board_support: on that board, mean and median trade return each improve at least 25 bp and CAGR improves at least 1.00 point
verdict_implementation.freshness_admission_edge: one lane has material trade and combined-portfolio improvement and board support on both Main and ChiNext
verdict_implementation.board_specific: one lane has board support on exactly one board and improves combined CAGR by at least 0.50 point
verdict_implementation.trades_but_not_portfolio: one lane has material trade improvement on combined completed trades but combined CAGR improvement is below 0.50 point or nonpositive
verdict_implementation.marginal: one lane improves combined CAGR by 0.50 to less than 1.00 point with nonnegative mean and median trade-return changes, or otherwise narrowly misses one material gate
